# Value Yonder — Daniel Araújo

> Personal site of Daniel Araújo, Principal PM at Zendesk specialising in AI product. Essays and thoughts on product strategy, org design, AI, and learning. Photography galleries from Lisbon, Israel, and San Francisco.

## About

Daniel Araújo is a Principal Product Manager with 15+ years of experience across Google, two startups (Attentive — conversational AI, Techstars Boulder; NovaWeb.pt), OutSystems, and Zendesk. Currently leading Admin Copilot at Zendesk — an AI assistant that helps support teams configure and manage their operations. Based in Lisbon, Portugal.

No ML degree. Product-first, not engineering-first. Writes about what AI actually does for people, not what it theoretically could.

## Content

- [Essays](https://valueyonder.com/essays) — Long-form writing organised into three themes: On Learning, On Progress, On Prosperity
- [Thoughts](https://valueyonder.com/thoughts) — Shorter notes and observations on strategy, product, and learning
- [Seeing](https://valueyonder.com/seeing) — Photography galleries from Lisbon, Israel, and San Francisco
- [Reading](https://valueyonder.com/reading) — Books read with ratings and notes
- [About](https://valueyonder.com/about) — Background and career timeline
